agent_priors_used: GENERAL PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): long-lived research agents over-exploit their deepest local thread (local attractor / sunk-cost) and under-invest in single shared prerequisites; a Global Director should prefer removing one shared blocker once over letting each lane re-discover the same absence.

GENERAL PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): a benchmark whose baselines sit at the ceiling has zero dynamic range and cannot detect a treatment effect even if the treatment is good - ceiling baselines are a null instrument, not weak evidence.

GENERAL PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): a treatment must be shown live and separable from its comparator before an expensive multi-arm benchmark is funded; arm-differentiation certificates belong upstream of economics runs.

GENERAL PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): a small CPU-quantized local model used as the flagship same-model endpoint risks measuring model capability rather than architecture; prompt specification and model ability are separate failure modes and must be separated experimentally before either is blamed.

allocation.question: Can a non-degenerate asymmetric-discovery task bank be certified arithmetically BEFORE freeze - with cold re-derivation and a retrieval-shaped comparator demonstrably below the success ceiling at high residual novelty, a real treatment/comparator behavioural distinction, honest per-condition counters (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts), and a preregistered contamination/dynamic-range certificate - and be delivered as a reusable substrate that unblocks the flagship inheritance benchmark (blocker B2), recording a bounded substrate-class negative and freezing nothing if the certificate is unsatisfiable on every credential-free substrate tested?
allocation.rationale: B2 is the audit's priority #2 and readiness condition (2): the task bank must give cold/retrieval baselines non-ceiling dynamic range and a treatment/comparator distinction. The immediately preceding Product packet (EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440) proved the frozen dynamic-range certificate is unsatisfiable on the mandatory-discovery deterministic credential-free REST class (B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED both at the 1.0 correctness ceiling at novelty >= 0.5 in families F1/F2), so a materially different substrate construction is required, not another version of the same one. Runtime is the correct owner because this is measurement/execution-substrate construction. The in-flight PREFREEZE mandate targets exactly this and forbids a fourth re-run of the degenerate certificate; if no credential-free substrate can supply dynamic range, recording that bounded substrate-class negative is itself decision-changing (it retires a class of cost-saving claims and redirects effort to procedure caching). I keep runtime here rather than returning it to the parent's out-of-surface oracle repair, because that repair is not a product blocker (C-MEAS-VALID is already VALIDATED at the bounded authorship-separated real-Chromium scope) whereas B2 gates the entire flagship benchmark.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: SPIDER's center of gravity remains unproven: no accepted packet establishes a net end-to-end cost reduction per successful, partially novel Web task for a real external agent under the same model/tools/budget, and 255 of 434 canonical packets are REVISE or MEASUREMENT_INVALID (26.0% MEASUREMENT_INVALID). The Program Audit Global (2026-10-10) isolates three hard blockers - B1 no promoted parameterized carrier in src/spider/kernel.py (distill_parameterized absent, literal distill candidate confidence 0.5 < 0.8 threshold), B2 benchmark degeneracy (cold and retrieval both pinned at the 1.0 success ceiling on the deterministic credential-free REST class), B3 unresolved agent capability (0/5 on tested 3B/7B endpoints under an underspecified prompt) - and the system-prompt readiness rule forbids funding the expensive C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON four-arm benchmark until ALL THREE conditions hold. Reading the whole machine snapshot rather than local continuity: every scientific lane now has in-flight work, and the in-flight portfolio already concentrates on exactly those blockers (Product -> B1 carrier promotion; Runtime -> B2 non-degenerate task bank; Intel -> B3 minimal endpoint capability) with Graph, Physics and Frontier as supporting programs. Nothing in the accepted Codex since the last decision invalidates that arrangement: the last graph packet parked the four-anchor C-FRESHNESS Part II route, the frontier v1 discovery freeze was a BLOCKED design defect (empty sampling frame) rather than a substrate negative, and the physics barrier question is already FROZEN and must complete under its frozen design. A cognitive reset was performed for every lane ('if this lane met today's Codex with no inherited next_question, what would it investigate?'); in each case the answer converges on the same blocker-removal or a directly adjacent decision-relevant question, so I am not pivoting for novelty's sake. I am also refusing two temptations explicitly: (a) no new expansion of C-WEB-DYNAMICS / physics cosmology while the product thesis is untested - physics continues only on the frozen barrier-stationarity timescale program that has direct dead-end-policy decision value; (b) no repeat of the parked four D1V freshness anchors. The one mild tension with the audit's 'keep Graph on freshness/safety' guidance is deliberate: the parked route leaves no ready non-four-anchor freshness test, whereas the active C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE confound-removal is a clean, cheap, product-critical capability test (NL goal -> applicable mechanism without internal ids) sitting directly beside the B1 carrier install. Recurring control-plane measurement invalids (freeze cannot hash code; V9 unsatisfiable; absent pre-freeze certificates) are treated as one prerequisite to repair once via the design-contract v2 protocol rather than a reason to buy another cycle in any lane.
